# `blocking-and-nonblocking`: One variable mixes blocking and nonblocking assignments / 同一变量混用了阻塞与非阻塞赋值

**Severity / 严重程度:** `error`

## English

### Cause

The same variable is written with both blocking and nonblocking assignment styles, often from different processes.

### Risk

The variable can have ambiguous scheduling and ownership, causing race-sensitive simulation results and synthesis failures.

### Fix

Give the variable one owner and use a consistent assignment discipline appropriate to that process.

## 简体中文

### 原因

同一变量同时被阻塞赋值和非阻塞赋值写入，且这些写入通常来自不同过程。

### 风险

变量的调度顺序和所有权会变得不明确，可能导致竞争相关的仿真结果和综合失败。

### 修复

为变量指定唯一写入者，并根据该过程的用途统一采用一种赋值方式。

## Failing example / 问题示例

```systemverilog
module blocking_and_nonblocking(
  input logic clk,
  input logic load,
  input logic data_i,
  output logic data_o
);
  always_comb begin
    if (!load) data_o = data_i;
  end

  always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
    if (load) data_o <= data_i;
  end
endmodule
```

## Fixed example / 修复示例

```systemverilog
module blocking_and_nonblocking(
  input logic clk,
  input logic load,
  input logic data_i,
  output logic data_o
);
  always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
    if (load) data_o <= data_i;
  end
endmodule
```
